configure_slack_alerting_args: configure slack alerting arguments with custom thresholds, TTLs, and report frequencies for LiteLLM deployments
define_alert_types: define alert types for LLM exceptions, budget alerts, outage alerts, and team events in LiteLLM slack integration
configure_alert_digest_mode: configure digest mode settings per alert type to aggregate duplicate alerts into summary messages
track_hanging_requests: track hanging LLM requests with request ID, model, API base, and alerting metadata for timeout detection
model_outage_states: model outage states for deployments and provider regions with minor and major alert tracking
